subject: storytime
title: Hamster Roommates words
about: Henry the hamster wants a little peace and quiet, but his roommate Marvin never stops talking, so after Henry finally loses his cool the two of them have to work out how to share one cage. This level teaches the words the child will meet in the story, so the library copy is easier to read on his own.
tip: Borrow the book from the library after the level and read it together, with him reading the words he practised.

book.author: Cheryl B. Klein
book.source: a library favorite; this level teaches its words, the app does not contain the book
book.blurb: A funny picture book about a quiet hamster, a chatty hamster and the cage they both call home.
